annotations.title: Find Hawaiʻi lots in an area

description: Answers questions across many Hawaiʻi lots at once: which lots near this address or TMK are zoned R-4, Agriculture or Resort, which lots in this plat are over an acre, which lots nearby are outside the FEMA flood zone, which are outside the Special Management Area, how big the neighbouring lots are. Lists lots in an area with each lot's acres, county zoning, FEMA flood zone and Special Management Area, filtered by zoning, size, flood and SMA. The area is a TMK prefix (island, zone and section at least, e.g. 4-4-2), or a radius of up to 3000 meters around a lot, an address or a point. Returns up to 50 lots, each with a link to its full sheet. Free: the first 3 lots of one search a day. The full list, on ParcelSheet Pro ($22 a month).

flood.description: in: center in a FEMA special flood hazard area. out: not.

island.description: Kauaʻi, Oʻahu, Maui County or Hawaiʻi Island. Not needed with tmk_prefix or near_tmk.

near_address.description: Or around this Hawaiʻi street address

radius_m.description: Meters around near_tmk or lat and lon. Default 500, up to 3000.

sma.description: in or out of the Special Management Area

tmk_prefix.description: Start of a TMK: island, zone, section and optionally plat, e.g. 4-4-2 or 4-4-2-016

zoning.description: Text to match in the zoning code or name, e.g. R-4, Agriculture, Resort

name: search_lots
